finding.text: At 400 the Created date filter runs off the right edge: the "to" input is cut in half (wrapping 1). The date and number filter rows are `flex` without `wrap`; the chip row has `wrap` and fits. Evidence: shots/…ext-DataGrid/400.png, filter band. layout.json says `overflow_x false` only because the overflow is clipped, not because it fits.

The listener count is wrong in three places (requirements, "say how many listeners"). DataGrid.js's header comment, doc/perf.md and the readme all say "exactly 4 listeners, ever". The class also adds a `click` listener (sort) on the header and a `scroll` listener on the grid, so the real count is 6, plus a `change` listener on each filter input. Still 0 on `document`, so the fix itself holds; only the number is wrong.

On a wide screen the grid is boxed into the ~600px text measure. At 3440 the page is 77% empty, and the Note column still clips its text ("Row 0 — filtered by status" wraps inside the cell). A data grid is a wide thing and should be allowed past the reading measure (sizing 1). Evidence: shots/…ext-DataGrid/3440.png, sheet.png; layout.json empty 0.774 at 3440.

The page tells before it shows (page 2). A dense paragraph and a code block come before the live grid, so at 400 only the header row of the grid is above the fold. Putting the live grid first and the code after it would show the takeaway straight away. Evidence: shots/…ext-DataGrid/400.png, 1200.png.

The readme's advice to set `--datagrid-height` to `"none"` breaks a windowed grid. DataGrid.css sets `block-size: var(--datagrid-height)`, and `block-size: none` is invalid there. The height falls back to `auto`, the grid grows to its full spacer height, and `clientHeight` then renders every row, so windowing turns off without any error.

`ui/datagrid` has no `readme.md` and no `doc/`, and CLAUDE.md asks every module for both. Its Index line in ui/readme.md also opens with "a resizable, sortable, filterable table", but this folder is the markup only and does none of that.

The brief says the resize writes "one CSS property per frame", but it actually writes one per `pointermove` event, with no rAF throttle. The measured 6.9ms/frame shows this is harmless today, so it is a note only.

review/diff.patch is the wrong diff. It holds `Server/worktree-restart.mjs` and `restart-observe/before-agents-2.json` (commits on michael/dev), and none of the DataGrid work. I reviewed the real branch instead, `worktree/data-grid` at f7f995b3, with `git diff michael/dev...HEAD` (17 files, ext/DataGrid + ui/datagrid + the ui wiring). Whatever builds the review patch for a worktree task should diff the worktree branch, not the main checkout.

The shots in shots/ were taken at 17:52, before the fix commit f7f995b3 (18:25). They show the old page, before the fixes. A fresh 400px shot of http://data-grid.localhost/framework/ext/DataGrid/ confirms two fixes: the date filter now wraps instead of clipping, and the live grid comes before the code. The 400/1200/1920/3440 set should still be re-shot before merge.

At 400px every filter input stretches to the full width, which looks like the site's global input width. The date and number filters take about 300px of height, so only five grid rows sit above the fold. Giving `.datagrid-filter input` an `inline-size: auto` (ext/DataGrid/DataGrid.css:17) would keep "from … to …" on one or two lines.

ext/DataGrid/DataGrid.js:192-195 rebuilds the whole visible slice (about 30 rows × 4 cells) on every `scroll` event, even when the first visible row hasn't changed. That works today. The simple speed-up: skip the rebuild when `start` is unchanged, or batch it into one `requestAnimationFrame`. The resize handler at :216 writes once per `pointermove` with no rAF throttle either, but the measured 6.9ms/frame shows that is harmless.

DataGrid.js:25 still says "Total listeners this class ever adds: 6". doc/perf.md:39 correctly adds that each filter input also gets one `change` listener (8 more on the demo). The header comment should say the same, so the two counts don't disagree.

The date comparator at DataGrid.js:71 uses `Date.parse(a[key] ?? 0)`. For a missing date that becomes `Date.parse("0")`, a real date in 2000 in V8, and an unparseable string gives `NaN`, which makes `sort` order unpredictable. Mapping NaN to -Infinity, the way `num()` does at :74, would fix both.

The requirements are all met. `datagrid()` is markup + CSS only (ui/datagrid/datagrid.js:131) and `DataGrid` imports it rather than copying it. Resize uses one delegated listener set on the header (no `document` listener), and the handle shows through plain CSS `:hover`. Sort re-renders only the body. The type-driven filters use a stated threshold (12 uniques in 300 rows). Windowing uses spacers, perf.mjs reports 6.95ms/frame and 10% CPU, the demo has 2,000 rows, and the ui.js / ui/page.js / ui/readme.md wiring is in place, including the UI/UX one-liner. sessions/page.js and sessions.css were not touched.
